content:
使用指令隱藏與自訂其他玩家的名字

指令

/hiddennames nameplateVisible [player(s)] [true/false]

/hiddennames defaultVisible [true/false]

/hiddennames blocksHideName [true/false] 當有方塊擋住時會隱藏姓名板

/hiddennames setName [player(s)] [colour] [animation] ["name"] 名稱參數必須用引號包圍

/hiddennames setName [player(s)] name ["name"]

/hiddennames setName [player(s)] colour [colour]

/hiddennames setName [player(s)] animation [animation]

/hiddennames setName [player(s)] reset


所有指令均需 2 級或以上的 OP 權限才能執行。

支援我

- 加入我的 Discord 伺服器
